description: Scripts injected into the REMOTE arena.ai page on desktop (injected/*.js via bridge.js). The dock is its own webview there (WebviewUrl::App dock.html), so the page only needs to hand over run tokens, relay page events to the dock, do allowlisted proxy GETs / Gist calls, open link tabs and end a re-login (login_clear). No event subscription (nothing in the page listens; only the dock does), no login_set (only the dock starts a re-login), no store, no window/webview APIs and no arena_command (the page must never eval into itself via Rust). The embedded-dock grants live in arena-mobile.json.
